content: SQLite upsert (since 3.24, bundled 3.53.4): INSERT INTO t(cache_key,value,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(cache_key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, expires_at=excluded.expires_at. For batches, wrap N executions of one prepared statement in a single explicit transaction (database/sql caches prepared statements per connection automatically). For explicit write transactions prefer BEGIN IMMEDIATE via driver DSN _txlock=immediate so the write lock is acquired up front; a deferred transaction that upgrades after a read can return SQLITE_BUSY immediately because the upgrade lock is non-blocking.
